author: Insta360
description:
We're on a mission to change the way the world sees sharks 🦈

This Shark Awareness Week, we're bringing you face-to-face with the world's most misunderstood animals to hopefully change perceptions and show why they're worth protecting—and how every diver can help.

Want to play your part? Together with @PADIAWARE , we're encouraging divers worldwide to contribute to the Global Shark & Ray Census. Every sighting, including old footage, becomes valuable data that helps protect endangered species, deepen our understanding of ocean health, and inform conservation efforts around the world.

Join the movement at https://pros-blog.padi.com/introducing-the-global-shark-ray-census-padi-awares-newest-citizen-science-program/.

Want to get even closer? Experience diving with sharks in 360 VR 👉 https://youtu.be/UNkrkcMJPqk

Huge thank you to Ari (@sharks), Andy Casagrande (@abc4explore), Roy Mauritsen (@rmdragon2), Zimy (@ZimyDaKid), Dr. Darren A. Whitehead, Colby Eubanks (@ColbyEubanks) and Deep
